title: Add product filtering by shape and category tabs to Marketplace header and create description template management system

requirements.text: Add filter tabs to the Marketplace home page header (frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx) that display all available shapes and categories as clickable tabs, allowing customers to filter the displayed products by selecting one or multiple shape/category filters

quotes: the filters appear, in home page header like tabs that filter by shape and/or category

acceptanceCriteria: Filter tabs appear in the Marketplace page header above the product sections
Tabs display all unique shapes from products in the system
Tabs display all unique categories from products in the system
Clicking a shape or category tab filters the product display to show only matching products
Users can select multiple filters (e.g., one shape + one category) to narrow results
Active filters are visually indicated with distinct styling
A 'Clear Filters' or 'All Products' option resets the filter state

requirements.text: Create React state management in Marketplace.tsx to track selected shape and category filters, and implement filtering logic that filters the product arrays (featured, most viewed, best selling, newest) based on the active filter selections

quotes: the filters appear, in home page header like tabs that filter by shape and/or category

acceptanceCriteria: Filter state tracks currently selected shapes and categories
Product lists dynamically update when filters change
Filtering preserves the original product section structure (featured, most viewed, etc.)
Empty states display appropriate messages when no products match the selected filters

requirements.text: Add a new 'Description Templates' tab to the admin Dashboard page (frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx) with a management interface that displays all existing description templates in a list or table format with options to create new templates, edit existing templates, and delete templates

quotes: i want to create the templates
product description generation to be managed by product description generation options, where i can add new ones

acceptanceCriteria: New 'Description Templates' tab appears in the Dashboard page navigation
Interface displays all existing description templates with their names and content preview
Create button opens a form to add a new description template
Each template has edit and delete action buttons
Templates are saved and persisted in the backend

requirements.text: Create a DescriptionTemplateManager component (frontend/src/components/DescriptionTemplateManager.tsx) that provides a form interface for creating and editing description templates with fields for template name and template content text, with save and cancel controls

quotes: i want to create the templates
product description generation to be managed by product description generation options, where i can add new ones

acceptanceCriteria: Form includes template name input field
Form includes template content textarea for the description text
Save button validates required fields and submits to backend
Cancel button resets form or closes the editor
Form supports both create and edit modes
Success feedback displays after successful save

requirements.text: Create React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for fetching all description templates (useDescriptionTemplates) and mutating description templates (useCreateDescriptionTemplate, useUpdateDescriptionTemplate, useDeleteDescriptionTemplate) with admin authentication

quotes: i want to create the templates

acceptanceCriteria: useDescriptionTemplates hook fetches all templates from backend
useCreateDescriptionTemplate hook creates new templates
useUpdateDescriptionTemplate hook updates existing templates
useDeleteDescriptionTemplate hook removes templates
All mutation hooks invalidate the templates query on success
Hooks include proper error handling and loading states

requirements.text: Update the BulkProductUpload component (frontend/src/components/BulkProductUpload.tsx) to replace the single default description template with a dropdown selector that displays all available description templates from the template management system, allowing the trader to select which template to use as the default pre-populated description for bulk uploaded products

quotes: i want to create the templates
product description generation to be managed by product description generation options

acceptanceCriteria: Template selector dropdown appears above the product upload grid
Dropdown displays all available templates by name
Selecting a template pre-populates the description field for all products with that template's content
Template selection works with the existing auto-copy functionality
Default template is selected automatically if only one exists
Template selection persists during the upload session

requirements.text: Create backend data structure in backend/main.mo to store description templates with fields for template ID, template name, template content text, and creation timestamp

quotes: i want to create the templates

acceptanceCriteria: DescriptionTemplate type includes id, name, content, and created timestamp fields
Backend maintains a stable data structure for storing templates
Templates are persisted across canister upgrades
Each template has a unique identifier

requirements.text: Create backend methods in backend/main.mo for managing description templates: getDescriptionTemplates() to retrieve all templates, createDescriptionTemplate(name, content) to add new templates, updateDescriptionTemplate(id, name, content) to modify existing templates, and deleteDescriptionTemplate(id) to remove templates, all with admin authentication

quotes: i want to create the templates

acceptanceCriteria: getDescriptionTemplates returns array of all templates
createDescriptionTemplate validates inputs and creates new template with unique ID
updateDescriptionTemplate finds and updates the specified template
deleteDescriptionTemplate removes the specified template
All methods verify admin authentication before execution
Methods return appropriate success/error responses

requirements.text: Create a default description template in the backend initialization with the current template text: 'Original 3D printed dolphin ocarina, uniquely designed and precision-crafted for beautiful sound and artisan appeal. This one-of-a-kind piece combines intricate detail with functional artistry, perfect for collectors and music enthusiasts alike'

quotes: i want to create the templates

acceptanceCriteria: System initializes with one default template on first deployment
Default template uses the specified content text
Default template is named appropriately (e.g., 'Default Product Description')
Default template can be edited or deleted by admin like any other template

constraints: Do not modify the shape field implementation that already exists in the BulkProductUpload component
Preserve the existing auto-copy functionality when adding template selection
Filter tabs must not interfere with existing hero section or product section layouts
nonGoals: Creating a search bar or text-based search functionality
Filtering by price ranges or other product attributes beyond shape and category
Advanced template features like variables, placeholders, or AI prompt configuration
